valuation_method_note: The prior 2026-09-06 operating scenarios are retained to isolate the newly material financing event. Scenario equity values are converted to total equity on the old share count, then a scenario value for the KRW 3tn rights-funded deployment is added and divided by the pro-forma 48.560951m shares. This is a bridge analysis, not a full standalone DCF of PolyPeptide. Bear/Base/Bull deployment values of 0.5x/1.0x/1.5x gross proceeds reflect acquisition/capex execution risk and potential strategic upside.
rights_and_capital: The rights issue is approximately 4.9% of the pre-offering share count. Because it is a rights offering, existing shareholders can preserve proportional ownership by contributing capital; nevertheless, per-share economics must use the pro-forma denominator and capital allocation must earn an adequate return on the new equity capital.
falsifier: If Plant 5/Rockville ramp-up, batch economics and collection do not improve over four reporting periods, or if PolyPeptide integration consumes materially more capital without durable FCF improvement, the moat/reinvestment thesis must be rewritten.
portfolio_instruction: Research completion is not a buy authorization. No position size is assigned without actual portfolio risk-budget information.
